```{r}
omics_df <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/omics_aibl_demo_clean_imputed.csv", na.strings = c("", "NA"), check.names = FALSE)
names_df <- readxl::read_excel("../preprocessed_data/feature_names_clean.xlsx")

clean_feature_name <- function(x) {
  sub("\\.[0-9]$", "", as.character(x))
}

clean_feature_vector <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  unique(clean_feature_name(x))
}

# Manuscript/display renaming only. Raw feature IDs are kept for matching,
# modelling, and exported reproducibility columns.
manuscript_feature_name_map <- c(
  "2_5-Dihydroxypyridine" = "dihydroxypyridine",
  "2,5-Dihydroxypyridine" = "dihydroxypyridine",
  "6beta-acetoxy-24-methylcholestan-3beta_5alpha_22R_24-tetrol" = "acetylated polyhydroxy-ergostanoid",
  "6beta-acetoxy-24-methylcholestan-3beta,5alpha,22R,24-tetrol" = "acetylated polyhydroxy-ergostanoid",
  # "7beta-acetoxy-gorgostan-3beta_5alpha_6beta-triol" = "acetylated polyhydroxy-ergostanoid",
  "6-Butyryl-5_7-dihydroxy-8-(3'_3'-dimethylallyl)-4-phenylcoumarin" = "4-phenylcoumarin",
  "6-Butyryl-5,7-dihydroxy-8-(3'_3'-dimethylallyl)-4-phenylcoumarin" = "4-phenylcoumarin",
  "Aminoadipic acid" = "aminoadipic acid",
  "cyclopentanehexanoic acid" = "oxo-hexadecanoic acid",
  "Cyclopentanehexanoic acid" = "oxo-hexadecanoic acid",
  "Cys/Asp/Asp/Thr/Thr" = "sulfur-containing pentapeptide",
  "DG(22:5/22:6/0:0)" = "DG(44:11)",
  "Dihomocholic acid" = "dihomocholic acid",
  "epithio-seco-cholestadienetriol S_S-dioxide" = "25-hydroxyvitamin D3 3-sulfate",
  "Epithio-seco-cholestadienetriol S,S-dioxide" = "25-hydroxyvitamin D3 3-sulfate",
  "FA hydroxy(7:0)" = "hydroxyheptanoic acid",
  "Methylimidazole acetaldehyde (MIA)" = "methylimidazole acetaldehyde (MIA)",
  "N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipate(2-)" = "N-acetyl-aminoadipic acid",
  "Pyrroline hydroxycarboxylic acid" = "pyrroline hydroxycarboxylic acid",
  "Stoloniferone F" = "unsaturated polyhydroxy-ergostanoid",
  "Sulfonic acid" = "sulfonic acid",
  "{[-3-phenylprop-2-en-1-yl]oxy}sulfonic acid" = "sulfonic acid",
  "3-Isopropyl-2-methoxy-5-methylpyrazine" = "methoxypyrazine",
  "Quinic acid" = "quinic acid",
  "Deoxyribose" = "deoxypentose",
  "Guanosine" = "guanosine"
)

manuscript_feature_name <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_feature_name(x)
  out <- unname(manuscript_feature_name_map[x])
  ifelse(is.na(out), x, out)
}

add_feature_display <- function(df, feature_col = "Feature") {
  df %>%
    mutate(Feature_Display = manuscript_feature_name(.data[[feature_col]]))
}

use_feature_display_for_plot <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    add_feature_display() %>%
    mutate(Feature_ID = Feature, Feature = Feature_Display)
}

normalise_sex <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(x %in% c("0", "Female"), "Female",
         ifelse(x %in% c("1", "Male"), "Male", x))
}

normalise_label <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(x %in% c("0", "N"), "N",
         ifelse(x %in% c("1", "H"), "H", x))
}

omics_df$Demographic.Sex <- factor(normalise_sex(omics_df$Demographic.Sex), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
omics_df$label <- factor(normalise_label(omics_df$label), levels = c("N", "H"))

keys                     <- clean_feature_vector(names_df$keys)
label_names              <- clean_feature_vector(names_df$label_names)
demographic_cols         <- clean_feature_vector(names_df$demographic_cols)
proteomic_cols           <- clean_feature_vector(names_df$proteomics_cols)
metabolomics_cols        <- clean_feature_vector(names_df$metabolomics_cols)
neuropsychological_cols  <- clean_feature_vector(names_df$neuropsychological_cols)

feature_cols <- unique(c(
  proteomic_cols,
  metabolomics_cols
  # neuropsychological_cols
))

univariate_p_cutoff <- 0.05
univariate_selection_label <- "Univariate volcano p < 0.05"
plsda_vip_cutoff <- 1
plsda_selection_label <- "PLS-DA VIP > 1"

feature_annotation <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Feature = proteomic_cols, Omics_Type = "Proteomics"),
  tibble(Feature = metabolomics_cols, Omics_Type = "Metabolomics")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Feature), Feature != "") %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(Omics_Type = paste(sort(unique(Omics_Type)), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop")

add_omics_type <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Feature = clean_feature_name(Feature)) %>%
    left_join(feature_annotation, by = "Feature") %>%
    mutate(
      Omics_Type = ifelse(is.na(Omics_Type), "Unmapped", Omics_Type),
      Feature_Display = manuscript_feature_name(Feature)
    )
}

summarise_selected_counts <- function(df, group_name, analysis_name, direction_col) {
  df %>%
    count(
      Analysis = analysis_name,
      Group = group_name,
      Omics_Type,
      Direction = .data[[direction_col]],
      name = "Selected_Features"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Analysis, Group, Omics_Type, Direction)
}

missing_feature_cols <- setdiff(feature_cols, colnames(omics_df))
if (length(missing_feature_cols) > 0) {
  warning("Feature columns missing after cleanup: ", paste(head(missing_feature_cols, 20), collapse = ", "))
}
feature_cols <- intersect(feature_cols, colnames(omics_df))
stopifnot(length(feature_cols) > 0)

# Define colors
pca_colors <- c(
  "Female-N" = "#E5ACA8",
  "Female-H" = "#C83231",
  "Male-N"   = "#94B3D1",
  "Male-H"   = "#2E5DA5"
)

amyloid_colors <- c("N" = "#C83231", "H" = "#2E5DA5")

# ============================================================================
# Panel A: PCA - Full cohort unsupervised structure
# ============================================================================

# Prepare data
X_all <- omics_df[, feature_cols] %>% as.matrix()
X_all_scaled <- scale(X_all)

# Run PCA
pca_all <- pca(X_all_scaled, ncomp = 2, center = FALSE, scale = FALSE)

# Create dataframe for plotting
pca_df_all <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_all$variates$X[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_all$variates$X[, 2],
  Sex = omics_df$Demographic.Sex,
  Amyloid = omics_df$label,
  Sex_Amyloid = paste(omics_df$Demographic.Sex, omics_df$label, sep = "-")
)

# Calculate variance explained
pve_all <- pca_all$prop_expl_var$X * 100

# Plot Panel A
panel_A <- ggplot(pca_df_all, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Sex_Amyloid)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.85) +  # Increased size from 3 to 5
  scale_color_manual(
    values = pca_colors,
    name = NULL,  # Remove "Group" title
    labels = c("Female-N" = "Female Amyloid-",
               "Female-H" = "Female Amyloid+",
               "Male-N" = "Male Amyloid-",
               "Male-H" = "Male Amyloid+")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - Full Cohort",
    subtitle = "Unsupervised multi-omic structure",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve_all[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve_all[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +  # Increased from 13 to 15
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),  # Increased by 2
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray30"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),  # Increased by 2
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),   # Increased by 2
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)  # Increased by 2
  )

# ============================================================================
# Panel B: PLS-DA - Full cohort supervised amyloid pattern
# ============================================================================

# Run PLS-DA
plsda_all <- plsda(X_all_scaled, omics_df$label, ncomp = 2)

# Create dataframe for plotting
plsda_df_all <- data.frame(
  Comp1 = plsda_all$variates$X[, 1],
  Comp2 = plsda_all$variates$X[, 2],
  Sex = omics_df$Demographic.Sex,
  Amyloid = omics_df$label,
  Sex_Amyloid = paste(omics_df$Demographic.Sex, omics_df$label, sep = "-")
)

# Calculate variance explained
pve_plsda_all <- plsda_all$prop_expl_var$X * 100

# Plot Panel B
panel_B <- ggplot(plsda_df_all, aes(Comp1, Comp2, color = Sex_Amyloid)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.85) +  # Increased size from 3 to 5
  scale_color_manual(
    values = pca_colors,
    name = NULL,  # Remove "Group" title
    labels = c("Female-N" = "Female Amyloid-",
               "Female-H" = "Female Amyloid+",
               "Male-N" = "Male Amyloid-",
               "Male-H" = "Male Amyloid+")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PLS-DA - Full Cohort",
    x = paste0("Component 1 (", round(pve_plsda_all[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("Component 2 (", round(pve_plsda_all[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +  # Increased from 13 to 15
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),  # Increased by 2
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),  # Increased by 2
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),   # Increased by 2
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)  # Increased by 2
  )

# ============================================================================
# Panel C: PLS-DA - Female
# ============================================================================

# Filter female data
df_f <- omics_df %>% filter(Demographic.Sex == "Female")
X_f <- df_f[, feature_cols] %>% as.matrix()
X_f_scaled <- scale(X_f)

# Run PLS-DA for females
plsda_f <- plsda(X_f_scaled, df_f$label, ncomp = 2)

# Create dataframe
plsda_df_f <- data.frame(
  Comp1 = plsda_f$variates$X[, 1],
  Comp2 = plsda_f$variates$X[, 2],
  Amyloid = df_f$label
)

# Calculate variance explained
pve_f <- plsda_f$prop_expl_var$X * 100

# Plot Panel C
panel_C <- ggplot(plsda_df_f, aes(Comp1, Comp2, color = Amyloid)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.85) +  # Increased size from 3 to 5
  scale_color_manual(
    values = amyloid_colors,
    name = NULL,  # Remove "Amyloid" title
    labels = c("N" = "Negative", "H" = "Positive")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PLS-DA - Female",
    x = paste0("Component 1 (", round(pve_f[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("Component 2 (", round(pve_f[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +  # Increased from 13 to 15
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),  # Increased by 2
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),  # Increased by 2
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),   # Increased by 2
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13)  # Increased by 2
  )

# ============================================================================
# Panel D: PLS-DA - Male
# ============================================================================

# Filter male data
df_m <- omics_df %>% filter(Demographic.Sex == "Male")
X_m <- df_m[, feature_cols] %>% as.matrix()
X_m_scaled <- scale(X_m)

# Run PLS-DA for males
plsda_m <- plsda(X_m_scaled, df_m$label, ncomp = 2)

# Create dataframe
plsda_df_m <- data.frame(
  Comp1 = plsda_m$variates$X[, 1],
  Comp2 = plsda_m$variates$X[, 2],
  Amyloid = df_m$label
)

# Calculate variance explained
pve_m <- plsda_m$prop_expl_var$X * 100

# Plot Panel D
panel_D <- ggplot(plsda_df_m, aes(Comp1, Comp2, color = Amyloid)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.85) +  # Increased size from 3 to 5
  scale_color_manual(
    values = amyloid_colors,
    name = NULL,  # Remove "Amyloid" title
    labels = c("N" = "Negative", "H" = "Positive")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PLS-DA - Male",
    x = paste0("Component 1 (", round(pve_m[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("Component 2 (", round(pve_m[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +  # Increased from 13 to 15
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),  # Increased by 2
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),  # Increased by 2
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),   # Increased by 2
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13)  # Increased by 2
  )

# ============================================================================
# Combine all panels
# ============================================================================

combined_plot <- (panel_A | panel_B) / (panel_C | panel_D)

# Display
print(combined_plot)

# Save
ggsave(
  "../plots/Figure2_PanelABCD_PCA_PLSDA_combined.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 14,  # Increased height to accommodate larger elements
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# Optional: Save individual panels
ggsave("../plots/Figure2_panelA_PCA_combined.pdf", panel_A, width = 7, height = 6.5)
ggsave("../plots/Figure2_panelB_PLSDA_combined.pdf", panel_B, width = 7, height = 6.5)
ggsave("../plots/Figure2_panelC_PLSDA_female.pdf", panel_C, width = 7, height = 6.5)
ggsave("../plots/Figure2_panelD_PLSDA_male.pdf", panel_D, width = 7, height = 6.5)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Loading plot with clear directional interpretation - SEPARATE PDFs
# Legend at BOTTOM
# ============================================================================

# For Female
loadings_f_comp1 <- plsda_f$loadings$X[, 1]  # Component 1
loadings_df_f_full <- data.frame(
  Feature = names(loadings_f_comp1),
  Loading = loadings_f_comp1,
  VIP = vip(plsda_f)[, 1]
) %>%
  mutate(Feature = clean_feature_name(Feature)) %>%
  add_feature_display() %>%
  filter(VIP > 1) %>%  # Only important features
  arrange(desc(abs(Loading))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = ifelse(Loading > 0, "Higher in Amyloid+", "Higher in Amyloid-"),
    AbsLoading = abs(Loading)
  )

plot_direction_f <- ggplot(loadings_df_f_full, 
                           aes(x = reorder(Feature_Display, Loading), 
                               y = Loading, 
                               fill = Direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Higher in Amyloid+" = "#C83231", 
               "Higher in Amyloid-" = "#E5ACA8"),
    name = "Association"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Loading on Component 1 (Female)",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    # y = "Loading on Component 1",
    subtitle = "Positive = elevated in amyloid+; Negative = elevated in amyloid-"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30"),
    legend.position = "none" 
    # legend.position = "bottom",
    # legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

# Save Female plot as separate PDF
ggsave("../plots/Figure2_PanelE_feature_directions_female.pdf", plot_direction_f, 
       width = 8, height = 8, device = "pdf")

# For Male
loadings_m_comp1 <- plsda_m$loadings$X[, 1]
loadings_df_m_full <- data.frame(

) %>%

ggsave("../plots/Figure2_PanelF_feature_directions_male.pdf", plot_direction_m,
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Extract and save PLS-DA features with VIP scores - FEMALE
# ============================================================================

# Get VIP scores for all features
vip_scores_f <- vip(plsda_f)[, 1]  # Component 1 VIP scores
loadings_f_comp1 <- plsda_f$loadings$X[, 1]  # Component 1 loadings

# Create comprehensive dataframe
plsda_features_f <- data.frame(
  Feature = names(vip_scores_f),
  VIP_Score = vip_scores_f,
  Loading_Comp1 = loadings_f_comp1,
  Selected = ifelse(vip_scores_f > plsda_vip_cutoff, "Yes", "No"),
  Direction = ifelse(loadings_f_comp1 > 0, "Higher in Amyloid+", "Higher in Amyloid-"),
  AbsLoading = abs(loadings_f_comp1)
) %>%
  add_omics_type() %>%
  arrange(desc(VIP_Score))

# Save to CSV
write.csv(plsda_features_f, 
          "../results/plsda_features_female_vip.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Also save only selected features (VIP > 1)
plsda_features_f_selected <- plsda_features_f %>%
  filter(Selected == "Yes")

write.csv(plsda_features_f_selected, 
          "../results/plsda_features_female_selected.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================================
# Extract and save PLS-DA features with VIP scores - MALE
# ============================================================================

vip_scores_m <- vip(plsda_m)[, 1]
loadings_m_comp1 <- plsda_m$loadings$X[, 1]

plsda_features_m <- data.frame(
  Feature = names(vip_scores_m),
  VIP_Score = vip_scores_m,
  Loading_Comp1 = loadings_m_comp1,
  Selected = ifelse(vip_scores_m > plsda_vip_cutoff, "Yes", "No"),
  Direction = ifelse(loadings_m_comp1 > 0, "Higher in Amyloid+", "Higher in Amyloid-"),
  AbsLoading = abs(loadings_m_comp1)
) %>%
  add_omics_type() %>%
  arrange(desc(VIP_Score))

write.csv(plsda_features_m, 
          "../results/plsda_features_male_vip.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

plsda_features_m_selected <- plsda_features_m %>%
  filter(Selected == "Yes")

write.csv(plsda_features_m_selected, 
          "../results/plsda_features_male_selected.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================================
# Optional: Print summary statistics
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== FEMALE PLS-DA Summary ===\n")
cat("Total features:", nrow(plsda_features_f), "\n")
cat("Features with VIP > 1:", sum(plsda_features_f$Selected == "Yes"), "\n")
cat("Mean VIP score:", round(mean(plsda_features_f$VIP_Score), 3), "\n")

cat("\n=== MALE PLS-DA Summary ===\n")
cat("Total features:", nrow(plsda_features_m), "\n")
cat("Features with VIP > 1:", sum(plsda_features_m$Selected == "Yes"), "\n")
cat("Mean VIP score:", round(mean(plsda_features_m$VIP_Score), 3), "\n")

plsda_selection_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarise_selected_counts(plsda_features_f_selected, "Female", plsda_selection_label, "Direction"),
  summarise_selected_counts(plsda_features_m_selected, "Male", plsda_selection_label, "Direction")
)

write.csv(plsda_selection_summary,
          "../results/Figure2_PLSDA_selected_counts_by_sex_omics_direction.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(
  plsda_selection_summary,
  caption = "PLS-DA selected feature counts by sex, omics layer, and direction."
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 2. Run Analysis
# ============================================================================
res_overall <- calc_de_stats(omics_df, "label", feature_cols)
res_overall <- res_overall %>% add_omics_type()

df_female <- omics_df %>% filter(Demographic.Sex == "Female")
res_female <- calc_de_stats(df_female, "label", feature_cols)
res_female <- res_female %>% add_omics_type()

df_male <- omics_df %>% filter(Demographic.Sex == "Male")
res_male <- calc_de_stats(df_male, "label", feature_cols)
res_male <- res_male %>% add_omics_type()

# ============================================================================
# Save Results to CSV
# ============================================================================
# # Create results directory if it doesn't exist
# dir.create("../results", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save with sorted by P-value
write.csv(res_overall %>% arrange(P_Value), 
          "../results/DE_results_Overall.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(res_female %>% arrange(P_Value), 
          "../results/DE_results_Female.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(res_male %>% arrange(P_Value), 
          "../results/DE_results_Male.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Save summary of significant features
sig_summary <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c("Overall", "Female", "Male"),
  Total_Features = c(nrow(res_overall), nrow(res_female), nrow(res_male)),
  Significant_Up = c(
    sum(res_overall$Significance == "Up"),
    sum(res_female$Significance == "Up"),
    sum(res_male$Significance == "Up")
  ),
  Significant_Down = c(
    sum(res_overall$Significance == "Down"),
    sum(res_female$Significance == "Down"),
    sum(res_male$Significance == "Down")
  )
)

write.csv(sig_summary, "../results/DE_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

univariate_selection_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarise_selected_counts(res_overall %>% filter(P_Value < univariate_p_cutoff, Significance %in% c("Up", "Down")), "Full Cohort", univariate_selection_label, "Significance"),
  summarise_selected_counts(res_female %>% filter(P_Value < univariate_p_cutoff, Significance %in% c("Up", "Down")), "Female", univariate_selection_label, "Significance"),
  summarise_selected_counts(res_male %>% filter(P_Value < univariate_p_cutoff, Significance %in% c("Up", "Down")), "Male", univariate_selection_label, "Significance")
)

univariate_total_summary <- univariate_selection_summary %>%
  group_by(Analysis, Group, Omics_Type) %>%
  summarise(Selected_Features = sum(Selected_Features), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Direction = "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(Analysis, Group, Omics_Type, Direction, Selected_Features)

univariate_selection_summary <- bind_rows(
  univariate_selection_summary,
  univariate_total_summary
) %>%
  arrange(Group, Omics_Type, Direction)

write.csv(univariate_selection_summary,
          "../results/Figure2_univariate_selected_counts_by_sex_omics_direction.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(
  univariate_selection_summary,
  caption = "Univariate selected feature counts by group, omics layer, and direction."
)

# ============================================================================
# 4. Generate & Save Separately
# ============================================================================

plot_volcano_with_forced_labels <- function(data, title, up_color, down_color,
                                            forced_labels = character(),
                                            n_up = 5, n_down = 5) {
  top_features <- bind_rows(
    select_top_features(data, n_up = n_up, n_down = n_down),
    data %>% filter(Feature %in% forced_labels, P_Value < univariate_p_cutoff)
  ) %>%
    distinct(Feature, .keep_all = TRUE)

  y_cutoff <- -log2(0.05)

  ggplot(data, aes(x = logFC, y = logP, color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = y_cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray80") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Up" = up_color,
      "Down" = down_color,
      "NS" = "gray85"
    )) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = top_features,
      aes(label = Feature, segment.colour = Significance),
      color = "black",
      size = 2.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 1.3,
      point.padding = 0.45,
      segment.size = 0.3,
      segment.alpha = 0.45,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      force = 6,
      force_pull = 0.35,
      direction = "both",
      seed = 42
    ) +
    scale_discrete_manual(
      aesthetics = "segment.colour",
      values = c(
        "Up" = up_color,
        "Down" = down_color,
        "NS" = "gray85"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Mean difference",
      y = "-Log2(P-Value)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}
```
